symptom: a newborn vomiting bile within hours of the very first feed
hook: the whole abdomen held just two bubbles of gas and nothing at all beyond them
whatYouSee: Two big gas bubbles sit side by side in the upper belly. Below them the bowel is completely empty of gas.
whyItMatters: The duodenum never opened up during development so nothing passes beyond it and about a third of these babies also have Down syndrome.
treatment: The blocked segment is bypassed surgically with a duodenoduodenostomy once the baby is resuscitated.
takeaway: Two bubbles and a gasless belly in a newborn is duodenal atresia.

Answer: Duodenal atresia

👀 What you see:
Two big gas bubbles sit side by side in the upper belly. Below them the bowel is completely empty of gas.

🦴 Why it matters:
The duodenum never opened up during development so nothing passes beyond it and about a third of these babies also have Down syndrome.

💊 Treatment:
The blocked segment is bypassed surgically with a duodenoduodenostomy once the baby is resuscitated.
